title: Pulitzer Prize-winning historian Annette Gordon-Reed to deliver Constitution Day address at UNI
summary_en: Pulitzer Prize-winning historian and Harvard University professor Annette Gordon-Reed will present "Thomas Jefferson and the Presidency" as the University of Northern Iowa's 2026 Constitution Day address.
